name: Initial_Check_by_SAC
title: Quick check of assigned submissions
instructions: Please take a quick look at this submission (1-2 minutes for each) and indicate whether it should proceed to review or be desk rejected for one of the listed reasons.

recommendation.description: Based on your quick check, should this paper proceed to full review ("Yes, ...") or be desk rejected for one of the listed reasons ("No, ...")?

enum: No, it exceeds the page limit
No, it is not properly anonymized

No, for another reason (please specify in the comments)

comment.description: Additional comments (required if you selected "No, for another reason" above):
